results.title: Breakthrough T1D Rochester Gala Honors Volunteers and Highlights Research Progress
results.description: Breakthrough T1D Rochester hosted its annual gala to celebrate progress in curing type 1 diabetes, featuring honoree Deanna Diecher and inspiring stories from teens living with the condition.

results.title: Prince William, Kate To Visit India In First Big Trip Since Her Cancer Diagnosis
results.description: Princess Kate of Wales is set for her most significant international trip since undergoing cancer treatment as she joins Prince William in India for the Earthshot Prize awards.
